flags.title: Chasing strength
flags.note: Extended — 96% up its 52-week range, RS 100, -3% from the high. Momentum isn't an edge by itself — define risk/stop before chasing.
flags.lesson: The market prices expectations; a late entry carries the drawdown, not the edge.

flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.
